verdict.rationale: Copilot cloud agent is documented as working independently in the background to complete tasks like a human developer, and tasks can be assigned to it. Automations can trigger it when an issue is opened, you can iterate by mentioning @copilot on the pull request, and the desktop workspace supports launching work from GitHub, reviewing changes and merging completed work. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that assigning an issue produces a complete pull request (the issue-to-PR flow is only implied across separate claims), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end workflow.
